paper.title: ScienceFlow: A long-horizon agent for ML research, scientific discovery and beyond
paper.peer_reviewed_venue: NOT_VERIFIED; no venue or journal-ref displayed on inspected official abstract page

source.locator_convention: 1-based physical LF lines, equivalent to nl -ba; no Unicode splitlines normalization

reading.scope: All 3191 lines of retained full-text extraction, including references and appendices, were read. Figure captions/text were read; original PDF figure rendering was not visually inspected. No code or raw experiment artifact replication.
reading.truncation_remediation: The combined first call retained lines 161–520; lines 1–160 were reread in a separate untruncated call. All subsequent chunks were returned without truncation.

claims.claim_ko: 실행 workspace, persistent memory, validation evidence, resource records를 함께 checkpoint하여 복구 가능한 연구 state를 구성한다.
ESTRA는 current/archive anchor와 extend/redirect를 교차 선택한다. 복구 뒤에도 resource accounting은 누적되고 원래 archive가 보존된다.
Add/Fold/Unfold/Assemble는 원문 result card를 보존하며 context를 압축·복구한다. 실패 branch도 negative evidence로 남는다.
과학 route는 worker가 선택하고 admission·lease·timebox·termination은 별도 controller가 runtime evidence와 remaining budget으로 제어한다. 단순 process liveness보다 검증 metric·recoverable artifact를 강한 progress evidence로 쓴다.
MLE full 75 tasks에서 3회 run mean±SEM 70.22±1.18% Any-Medal은 저자 보고다. 비교군은 모델·hardware·concurrency·12/24/36h budget·일부 corrected task setting이 다르다.
Lite 22-task ablation은 24h 누적 first-medal 지표의 세 seed mean±sample SD: full 80.30±2.62%, ESTRA 제거 66.67±2.62%, execution-control 제거 69.70±5.25%. 단일 final-artifact 결과 또는 graph 효과와 동일하지 않다.
한 task의 과거 decision 7개에서 4 action×3 seeds×4h=84 state-matched replay branches를 비교했다. 일부 선택은 4h horizon에서 실패하고 원래 5.26h 뒤 유효해져 horizon dependence가 드러났다.
SciModelingBench 비교는 같은 DeepSeek backbone, 2h, task별 8–20 batch quota, 8 logical CPU/no accelerator/<32 GiB다. 각 system-task는 한 번 실행하여 best-valid submission을 보고한다.
SciModelingBench의 DrugMatrix 여섯 endpoint는 동일 study collection이므로 하나의 group으로 집계하며 총 일곱 group을 동등 가중한다. runtime hidden-label boundary를 두지만 pretraining contamination-free는 주장하지 않는다.
Appendix 비용은 성공 run의 first-medal까지 LLM/API만 계산하며 accelerator 비용은 제외한다. first-medal 시간은 성공 run에 조건화하고 표의 체크는 run 중 하나 이상 성공이다. 일부 외부 baseline missing runs를 Any-Medal 실패로 계산한다.
Mechanism telemetry는 75 tasks 중 54에만 완비된다. storage sensitivity는 33 measured tasks의 observed footprint violations 적용이며 one-GPU 결과도 기록된 configuration 기반 estimate로 설명되어 fresh constrained rerun 근거가 아니다.
KTTSP memory folding·peer guidance는 single-run trace이며 인과 효과가 아니다. math comparison은 best audited scores·heterogeneous budgets, invalid candidate 제외, 일부 raw artifacts 미복제로 제한된다.
읽은 원문은 typed dependency edge invalidation, protocol-version 적용성 변경의 의무 재검증, 동일 의무를 가진 graph/non-graph 대조를 명시하거나 분리 검증하지 않는다. 미보고는 부재의 증명이 아니며 graph package 우위나 독창성 증거가 아니다.

bcg_mapping.B: A strong source-backed persistent tree must retain runnable artifacts, addressable original/negative evidence and budget-preserving restoration; ScienceFlow is a functional comparator inspiration, not an exact B implementation or external win claim.
bcg_mapping.C: Automatic checkpoint/evaluation stage gates and physical admission control exist in this source; they are not equivalent to schema-neutral compulsory applicability/revalidation/preservation/capsule research obligations. Keep shared operational controls common to all arms.
bcg_mapping.G: The source does not isolate typed dependency invalidation/graph-mediated continuation from a C comparator with equal obligations. G-C remains a graph-control package hypothesis, not topology alone.

keep_common: recoverable executable workspace + original result-card addresses
retention of invalid, failed and no-artifact evidence
same evidence rights, worker budget, model and final selector across B/C/G
prototype_implications.testable_residual: After task-supported upstream evidence or protocol applicability changes across recovery, can versioned dependency traversal reduce stale downstream reuse and improve one locked final artifact under the same total budget versus compulsory schema-neutral checks? No efficacy or novelty established.
measurement_design: Use one preregistered agent-selected artifact lock and post-termination hidden scoring; retrospective archive-best and first-medal are secondary descriptive only.
Count full cumulative LLM/control/replay/retrieval and execution costs, including failed branches and work after first success; match or report CPU/GPU-hours, tokens and wall time separately.
Retain launch/process UNKNOWN, no-lock/no-artifact, scorer failure and unobserved numeric score separately; do not infer hidden score zero or universal failure imputation from external tables.
Treat same-source endpoints, captured states and seeds as nested within programmes; keep confirmation ancestry separate.
Use state-matched replay as a bounded developmental diagnostic; its seven states and 84 branches do not provide 84 independent efficacy units.

do_not_reuse: No local efficacy, graph superiority, power prior, runtime admission, or native construction claim follows.
Do not label pretrained-model contamination-free, compute-normalized SOTA, or peer-reviewed publication from this review.
Do not reuse author headline, archive-best, first-medal or descriptive cost metrics as the local single-lock primary estimand.
Scientific task mechanisms produced during KTTSP are task artifacts, not fixed ScienceFlow modules.
